units: Gen. R. s. 75 לובשי ב׳ clad in iron armor; a. fr.—צאן ב׳ flock sold to payment in terms under the condition that the young be divided until the payment in full has taken place.

Bekh. II, 4, v. וָלָד.—(נכסי) עבדי צאן ב׳ mort-main, wife’s estate held by her husband, which, in case of her death or divorce, he must restore in specie, being responsible whith all his landed property for loss or deterioration.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 7:1">Yeb. VII, 1</cite>; a. fr.; v. <cite ref="N00841"><he>נְכָסִים</he></cite>.
